announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: Griffin Mining Ltd. publishes its half-year financial report following a completed share buyback programme in June.

announcements.headline: Result of Share Buyback
announcements.insight: Griffin Mining Ltd. reports the outcome of its June share buyback programme following the May AGM mandate.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results follow the May meeting notice. Shareholders should monitor the subsequent June share buyback programme for execution details.

announcements.headline: SHARE BUY BACK PROGRAMME
announcements.insight: Griffin Mining Ltd. announces a share buyback programme following its May 2026 AGM. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent details on execution and funding.

announcements.headline: ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING
announcements.insight: Griffin Mining Ltd. is holding its annual general meeting. Shareholders should watch for voting results on ordinary business items.
